arguments.name: Animation Poses
arguments.description: Per shot, after the timing chart and before the key sheet (D83): write the pose sheet poses/<shot>.json, the keys of the whole shot as curves the solver can build (line of action class and bow, weight foot, lead side, silhouette, plate family), with breakdowns that are poses (passing position, anticipation, overshoot, settle), secondaries that lag, and moving holds; the gate measures the key sheet against it.

arguments.name: episode_root
arguments.description: Episode directory holding the contracts (charts/, keys/, poses/, layouts/, blocking/, timeline.json), rubric.md and studies/.

arguments.name: renderer
arguments.description: The rendering project root: where src/library/animation/pose.ts, scripts/animation/ and the model sheets live.

arguments.name: context
arguments.description: The previous step's result (the timing chart's key list) or owner notes.

arguments.name: output_root
arguments.description: Caller-owned production artifact directory for studies and receipts.
